data.source_check: decoded sampled source tokens match cached question SHA256; no protected overlap
data.selection: uniform original row identities without replacement; no long weighting or loss selection

protocol.CE: sum unsmoothed FP32 token NLL / all non-PAD target tokens, including EOS; float64 reduction
protocol.accuracy: raw-logit argmax per position under teacher forcing; gold prefix; EOS included, PAD ignored

L2_search.reason: specified cleanup directory absent, inaccessible, or no matching FP16 checkpoint

bootstrap.unit: question row; independent train/heldout resampling, paired model differences
bootstrap.limitations: conditional on checkpoints/split; no seed, training, or repeated-selection uncertainty
